rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that one thing is connected with or relates to another.

example.english: This issue does relate to our work.
example.traditional: 呢個問題的確同我哋嘅工作有關。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 dik1 kok3 tung4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 zok3 jau5 gwaan1

rows.note: Use this everyday verb for telling or recounting something, such as a story or anecdote.

example.english: I often relate really funny stories to my friends.
example.traditional: 我成日同朋友講啲好搞笑嘅故事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 pang4 jau5 gong2 di1 hou2 gaau2 siu3 ge3 gu3 si6

rows.note: Use this when a rule, issue, or matter concerns or applies specifically to a particular subject.

example.english: This regulation does relate specifically to minors.
example.traditional: 呢項規定涉及未成年人士。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 kwai1 ding6 sip3 kap6 mei6 sing4 nin4 jan4 si6

rows.traditional: A 同 B 有共鳴
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B jau5 gung6 ming4
rows.note: Use this when someone emotionally or intellectually identifies with another person, character, or experience.

example.english: I really relate to this character.
example.traditional: 我同呢個角色好有共鳴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 hou2 jau5 gung6 ming4
